newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays in range as dollar/majors recover.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays in range as dollar/majors recover.

text.p: The ringgit was rangebound in quiet late Asian trading as the dollar recovered slightly against other major currencies, dealers said on Monday.
They said the ringgit was mainly following the majors, though there was buying interest around 2.5210 level.
There was little activity in the ringgit as most of the market concentrated on Thai baht due to elections in Thailand.
"There is dollar buying interest towards 2.52, but there is also interbank profit-taking above 2.5260," a dealer with a European bank in Singapore said.
He said some U.S. investors were seen buying dollar/ringgit around 2.5230 level.
Dealers forecast that the ringgit would trade in a 2.5200/80 range this week amid low volumes.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5235/40 a dollar against 2.5235/45 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Friday. The Singapore dollar was steady at 0.5545/49 a ringgit.
